data.name: Jeevika
data.long_meaning: Jeevika is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jeev' meaning 'life'. The suffix 'ka' denotes the feminine gender. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of life is often personified as Aditi, the mother of all gods. Thus, Jeevika is a name that symbolizes the nurturing and sustaining power of life.

The name Jeevika is not only a beautiful sounding name but also carries a profound meaning that reflects the ancient Hindu wisdom and philosophy.

The name resonates with the concept of Aditi, the goddess of fertility, nourishment, and protection. Jeevika is believed to embody the power of creation, growth, and preservation. The name inspires a deep sense of reverence for the power of life and a profound appreciation for the divine mother who sustains us. It is a reminder of our interconnectedness with all forms of life and the unity of all existence.
